definitions.explanation: Romantic love between two people, encompassing the feelings, relationship, and experience of being in love. Refers to the concept of romantic love in general or a specific romantic relationship.

examples.japanese: {恋愛|れんあい}{小説|しょうせつ}を{読|よ}む。
{恋愛|れんあい}{結婚|けっこん}と{見合|みあ}い{結婚|けっこん}のどちらが{多|おお}いですか。
examples.english: Which is more common, love marriages or arranged marriages?

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しくて、{恋愛|れんあい}をする{余裕|よゆう}がない。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that I don't have time for romance.

notes:
{恋愛|れんあい} combines {恋|こい} (love, romantic longing) and {愛|あい} (love, affection) to form a compound meaning romantic love.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {恋愛|れんあい}する: to be in a romantic relationship, to have a romance
- {恋愛|れんあい}{結婚|けっこん}: love marriage (as opposed to arranged marriage)
- {恋愛|れんあい}{小説|しょうせつ}: romance novel
- {恋愛|れんあい}{感情|かんじょう}: romantic feelings
- {恋愛|れんあい}{相談|そうだん}: relationship advice
- {恋愛|れんあい}{対象|たいしょう}: romantic interest, object of one's love

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恋愛|れんあい}: romantic love (the concept or experience as a whole)
- {恋|こい}: love, being in love (more emotional, longing-focused)
- {愛|あい}: love (broader; includes familial, platonic)
- {愛情|あいじょう}: affection, love (emotional warmth, not limited to romance)
